recommendation: Tail is low after Friday futures closed without a verified persistent one-way NQ path; residual risk is concentrated in weekend headline and reopening-gap uncertainty.
headline: Weekend closure lowers active Tail after two-way Friday session
body: Friday ended with the Nasdaq higher but negative broad breadth, Treasury yields near 5% and crude above $100. Futures are now closed, so no live price path exists. The session's large two-way range did not confirm persistent mean-reversion failure; weekend energy and geopolitical headlines keep Stress high.
